en.owner_auth.passkey_recovery.help: If every passkey is lost, run fuckipv6 recover-owner on the node host. There is no public recovery endpoint.

en.owner_auth.reauth.description: This security operation requires passkey reauthentication within the last five minutes. The original operation continues automatically after reauthentication.
